question: Simplify: x² - (3x - 2)(x + 5)
solution:
**Given:**

x² - (3x - 2)(x + 5)

**Formula used:**

(a - b)(c + d) = ac + ad - bc - bd

**Calculations:**

x² - (3x - 2)(x + 5)

⇒ x² - [3x × (x + 5) - 2 × (x + 5)]

⇒ x² - [3x² + 15x - 2x - 10]

⇒ x² - [3x² + 13x - 10]

⇒ x² - 3x² - 13x + 10

⇒ -2x² - 13x + 10

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
